additional_concerns: The formula treats a preserved application as a categorical bar to relief. The source expressly preserves its processing route; whether that necessarily excludes item (ii) relief, including after withdrawal or resolution, remains unresolved.
The commencement date is explicit, but the legally relevant assessment event is not. A freely selected assessment_date could produce relief for a change whose relevant event occurred earlier.

The relevant FAQs, applicable home-jurisdiction requirements and existing approval process are not supplied. The two unbound dependency IDs have no identifying metadata, so neither can safely be assigned to a particular missing authority.

The supplied classifications are inputs, not implemented legal assessments. Formula evaluation alone cannot establish home-jurisdiction compliance or resolve novel features, complexity or possible local policy implications.
A false result establishes only failure of the proposed relief test. It does not establish an approval duty, and a true result does not discharge notification, filing or post-vetting requirements.
